notes.title: Hardening / turning hearts
notes.body: This theological retelling attributes Egyptian hostility within a providential narrative. It must not erase human agency or become a template for claiming that modern hatred, oppression, or war was divinely caused or required.

translation_notes: This chapter completes corpus coverage as a ChatGPT-authored draft. KJV is retained as a familiar comparison layer; a separate automated reference pass adds BSB and pointed Hebrew without replacing the restored draft.
safety_note: Plague and conquest memories must not authorize collective punishment, anti-Egyptian racism, or modern territorial dispossession.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Psalms witnesses where extant, and other textual witnesses during the global audit.
